svg.title: Kotlin ARC controller UI and client — proposed (UML class notation)

g.text: Kotlin ARC controller UI and client — proposed (UML class notation)
Android composition injects ProtocolArcClientFactory. Each client owns its codec.
Target credentials are loaded only through admitted CredentialVault access.
No separate handshake. Capabilities-first is a convention.
Cancel enum8 is not a supported v1 command.
constructs per-connection adapter from admitted plan
injected domain factory; no protocol import
credential verifier writes use the single serialized repository writer
admitted outbound secret only, never UI frame state
local connection epoch plus protocol frame sequence; remote root unknown
